architecture.trainable_encoder: None beyond standard U-Net conditional layers

modules: Explicit world relation and motion feature transform; standard4-channel diffusion U-Net

observation_transform.raw_features: Raw39 with xyz position groups [0:3,4:7,11:14,18:21,22:25,29:32,36:39] centered by fixed world origin o=(0,0.6,0.1)m and divided by 0.1m. Gripper unchanged. Normalize each nonzero xyzw quaternion to unit norm and canonical sign w>=0; absent object2 quaternion remains zeros.
observation_transform.relations: Append (stick-hand, container-stick, goal-container, container-hand, goal-stick, goal-hand)/0.1m in world xyz axes, in this order (18 channels).
observation_transform.motions: Append (current.hand-previous.hand, current.stick-previous.stick, current.container-previous.container)/0.01m (9 channels), raw native previous fields. These are frame differences, not velocity per second.
observation_transform.history: Apply per raw observation in the two-observation history; no time or hidden route channel.
observation_transform.normalization: Fixed scales for all66 dimensions; normalizer passthrough(all), no D_N fit needed.

action_transform.encode: Identity on all4 native world dx,dy,dz,gripper action channels. Native xyz*0.01m defines commanded displacement.
action_transform.decode: Identity then clip all4 native world components to [-1,1].
action_transform.normalization: Actions native scale, no fitted normalization.

losses_and_weights.application: Every sampled window, tail mask; no additional action loss.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Differences between point coordinates express relative position in metres and cancel common translations; gravity fixes world z. These are algebraic facts, not inferred invariance of the robot or table.

Demo1 steps0-30 and demo2 steps0-30 lower the hand while closing around the stick; later hand-stick offsets stabilize near x=0.024m,z=0.043m. Steps43/42 onward lift and transport, with container moving only late (roughly steps67/64).
Explicit hand-stick, tool-container and container-goal relations may weaken the incidental training correlation between stick_x and target_y.
A horizontal orthonormal basis can align its x-axis to container-to-goal displacement while leaving gravity z unchanged; inverse rotation recovers world displacements exactly.

Goal-frame actions may transfer lateral target variation, but fixed robot and stick geometry can make this representation worse. Retaining frame direction and world anchor preserves those asymmetries.

architecture.trainable_encoder: None beyond standard U-Net conditional layers

observation_transform.basis: At current/latest replan observation c=container xyz and g=goal xyz. e1=(g_x-c_x,g_y-c_y,0)/horizontal norm; norm<1e-6m uses (1,0,0). e2=(-e1_y,e1_x,0), e3=(0,0,1). R=[e1 e2 e3].
observation_transform.raw_features: Use P1 layout but positions become R^T(p-c)/0.1m, all relations R^T(delta)/0.1m, motions R^T(delta)/0.01m. Quaternion channels remain normalized canonical world xyzw, never rotated as position vectors.
observation_transform.append: Append (c-(0,0.6,0.1)m)/0.1m and e1_x,e1_y (5channels), preserving absolute context.
observation_transform.history: Both observation rows, including their embedded previous positions and goals, use the SAME latest replan c,R.

action_transform.encode: For every valid action in the16-step chunk, encoded_xyz=R^T*world_native_xyz; gripper unchanged. Do not clip encoded rotated values.
action_transform.decode: world_native_xyz=R*encoded_xyz, gripper unchanged; then native4 cube clipping. This is equivalent to rotate native_xyz*0.01m then divide by0.01m.
action_transform.frame: Use current replan c,R throughout every chunk. Recompute only at next replan; never future object position.
action_transform.normalization: Native action scale, no fitted normalization.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Differences between point coordinates express relative position in metres and cancel common translations; gravity fixes world z. These are algebraic facts, not inferred invariance of the robot or table.

Demo1 steps0-30 and demo2 steps0-30 lower the hand while closing around the stick; later hand-stick offsets stabilize near x=0.024m,z=0.043m. Steps43/42 onward lift and transport, with container moving only late (roughly steps67/64).
Explicit hand-stick, tool-container and container-goal relations may weaken the incidental training correlation between stick_x and target_y.
A manipulating hand, held tool and pushed object have coupled motions, but action-to-motion dynamics depend on contact and cannot be inferred as a universal rigid controller.
Jointly denoising action and short-horizon physical motions may encourage a contact-sensitive action representation. Sparse successful trajectories may instead make the auxiliary task misleading.
